reason: I do lose track of applications, so the tracker sounds useful, but running a database and getting provider keys set up feels like another project I would not finish during internship hunting. I would keep using my spreadsheet and the job boards I already check.
objection: I don't know how much time or technical setup it takes before I can use it, and I don't want surprise API or hosting bills.
would_change_my_mind: A safe, no-key demo that shows the workflow and a setup guide with real time and cost expectations; ideally it works on my laptop without maintaining a server.
